title: Applying for a summer internship
situation: You would like to work in tourism after you finish school, and you have seen the advertisement below on a careers website. Write a formal e-mail to Ms Grant to apply for the internship.
situationHu: Turisztikai pályára készülsz, és egy budapesti szálloda nyári gyakornoki programjára jelentkezel; írj hivatalos e-mailt Ms Grantnek.
stimulus:
SUMMER INTERNSHIP PROGRAMME
The Danube Grand Hotel, Budapest, offers a six-week paid internship for secondary school students interested in tourism and hospitality.
Interns will work at the reception desk and help organise programmes for our international guests.
Good English and communication skills required.
To apply, write to our Human Resources Manager, Ms Julia Grant.

points.text: explain why you are interested in this internship and how it would help your future plans
describe the skills and experience that make you a suitable candidate
ask about the working hours and whether interns receive any training

usefulPhrases.hu: A … oldalon meghirdetett nyári gyakornoki programra szeretnék jelentkezni.

usefulPhrases.en: I am particularly interested in a career in tourism.
This internship would give me valuable work experience.
usefulPhrases.hu: Ez a gyakornoki program értékes munkatapasztalatot adna.

usefulPhrases.en: I have good communication skills and I work well under pressure.
